# Pinned, unmodified math.js browser distribution

mathjs 14.8.1, obtained independently from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjs/-/mathjs-14.8.1.tgz

Verified package integrity (SHA-512, base64):
7UDitJFsXoPbFdK2V7S6uJp7krx9B5bQSzAvCnh7ecsceSK4w0PBbEt9B3IRg9lHqzjk3YJNT1fZg/BNK+4CQw==

`math.js` is package/lib/browser/math.js, embedded in the Go binary. No Node,
browser, remote download, or Heynote code is required at runtime. LICENSE,
NOTICE and math.js.LICENSE.txt accompany the distribution and local app bundle.
THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt preserves licenses from the dependencies pinned in
the official v14.8.1 package-lock.json (including inline upstream notices).
Yohaku's evaluator deliberately exposes only a bounded scalar subset.
